articles.title: Show HN: I built a Python obfuscator that keeps production traces debuggable
articles.summary: pyobfus is a modern Python code obfuscator designed to protect source code by making it harder to reverse-engineer. Utilizing an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) approach, it includes framework-aware presets and supports AI-assisted debugging through reverse stack-trace mapping. This tool enhances software security for Python applications, ensuring intellectual property protection for developers and potentially aiding in securing critical software systems.

articles.title: Lanterns TV Teaser Offers Another Look at Ulrich Thomsen's Sinestro
articles.summary: A new TV teaser for the upcoming series 'Lanterns' has been released, offering viewers an additional glimpse of Ulrich Thomsen portraying the character Sinestro. The show is developed by Chris Mundy, Damon Lindelof, and Tom King, marking an update for fans of the fictional universe and its characters.

articles.title: Forward-Deployed USS Minnesota Completed Maiden Patrol
articles.summary: The U.S. Navy's Virginia-class fast-attack submarine USS Minnesota (SSN 783) returned to its homeport at Naval Base Guam on July 29, 2026, transiting Apra Harbor. This routine deployment and return underscore the U.S. Navy's persistent operational presence and strategic capabilities in the Indo-Pacific region, emphasizing the critical role of advanced submarine assets in maintaining national security and regional stability.
